fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.4 keeps the validated physical-furniture OCum behavior from v0.35.3 and adds a dedicated non-destructive CumOverlays replay for free/wall scenes only: new RaceMenu overlays are materialized directly on the local player and STR proxy, followed by lightweight SKEE refreshes at immediate, T+350 ms and T+1100 ms phases. Physical TESFurniture scenes, PPA, scene anchors and OCum equip meshes are unchanged; the unsafe live NiSkinInstance cloning experiment remains disabled.
